migrations.source: Only commanders whose currently equipped gear meets this limit can launch this function. Stats are discovered from live commander equipment and resolved by official effect and unit IDs. Event-scoped effects remain distinct and show their official target areas.
No matching bonus-troop stats were found on the current commander equipment.
Choose the commanders each automation may launch.

Every function defaults to all commanders. Use a function in the table header to toggle it for the full roster, or adjust individual commanders below. Right-click a header function to require a minimum or maximum equipped bonus-troop stat. Live availability and feature-specific requirements are still checked before each launch.
Focus a castle with map coords to see distance from your castle.

Drag horizontally to inspect a custom time period.
New confirmed reports for this automation will begin populating this view.

No alliance aggregate for the current filters.
No parsed leader effects for this report.
No lane details parsed for this wave.
Troop and tool metadata is unavailable; save will unlock after the automatic retry.
Loading official troop and tool metadata before save.
Each wave is checked independently. The server checks the actual target again before CRA is sent.

Treat each selected troop as a family anchor. At launch, CitadelOps uses the highest owned tier first, keeps partial higher-tier fills, then fills the remaining capacity with lower tiers from the same official family.
The preset can still be saved. Live inventory will be validated before an attack launches.
Preset exceeds the selected target type’s tool limits
Reduce tools in each listed section before saving. Limits apply separately to every wave.
No Sceat attack support tools are available in this inventory.
Every owned castle’s next troop return
No castles are available in the current game state.
Non-whitelisted game rejections pause only their originating lane for 30 minutes. Lanes resume normal eligibility checks when the cooldown expires; whitelisted responses never create a lane lock.
No saved presets for this castle.
Every position is fixed. Select a tool from its card; gate positions accept gate tools only.
The flank split must total 100%. Ranged percentage is converted to the game’s melee-percentage wire value.
Each defense section has one fixed moat-tool position.
Capacity, ranged allocation, three keep-tool slots, and three Sceat-support slots are part of the preset.
DFK has three normal keep-tool slots and three Sceat defense-support slots. Each row is validated against its official catalog type.
Choose a design to inspect its full upgrade chain.
Official CID and active duration by tier
Close this window and reopen the application to run the new binary.
No production queues observed for this castle.
Open the castle in-game to refresh its buildings and queues.
The page will switch automatically when a supported event begins.
This game action cannot be reversed.
Only storage and pieces already on this commander are eligible. Equipment on other commanders is never moved.

Applying removes all five base equipment slots first. Only matching event pieces are re-equipped, so missing pieces leave their slots empty. The server refuses to clear the commander when no matching equipment is available.
This commander is busy and cannot be reconfigured.
The configured coin reserve currently blocks upgrades.
PvP and PvE cover their broadly applicable effects. Event cards add official effects restricted to that target family, and new complete families appear automatically from current game data.
Add at least one battle stat to preview a loadout.
Each draggable row is the same official game-data effect group shown in the Equipment view's Effective Battle Report.
When previewing, CitadelOps expands that group into every target-compatible official effect definition. New definitions therefore join their catalog group automatically.
The server searches storage plus the selected leader’s current pieces, respects official caps and set bonuses, and never borrows gear from another leader.
Equipment or official metadata changed after this batch was generated. Review a fresh preview before applying.
No mapped equipment effects are available for this loadout.
Live data returned directly by the GGE event leaderboard.
GGE returns a window around the current alliance. The total reflects the full leaderboard, and every top-level and row field returned by the Nomad ranking endpoint is shown above.
Final known account score for each collected, completed event run—not points attributed to an automation. Newest first; dates use this device’s local time.
Connect the game once to begin collecting player analytics.
Choose one unit, or combine type, role, and food filters.
Six stacked lines: the five highest-count matching units plus Other. The upper boundary equals the filtered total.
Earlier total-only samples cannot be separated by category. New recorded samples will build this filtered trend.
Current troops grouped by weapon type and battlefield role.
Composition includes troops recognized by the current game metadata; the total trend still includes every tracked troop.
Saving or enabling automation never consumes a token. Activation is a separate confirmed command.
A running Nomad or Samurai event is required.
The game accepted MCM for this chain. Its remaining advisor attacks are cancelled, and CitadelOps will not restart it automatically.
If the event has not started, Auto Advisor selects the configured unlocked difficulty first.
The emitted AAC is the smallest safe count allowed by this limit, event time, complete preset copies, coins, rubies, feathers, and one-command cooldown skips. It never exceeds 9,999.

The coin value is the conservative total per attack, including a coin horse when selected. Ruby horses require a positive observed ruby cost per attack; travel-feather runs use one PTT per attack instead.

Auto Advisor launches only after the game reports the advisor unlocked. It never buys or activates a token on its own. A failed, completed, or MCM-cancelled run is terminal for that event and is not silently replaced.
Activation unlocks advisor attacks for the rest of this event. If Auto Advisor is enabled and its settings are valid, it may launch the single resource-sized run immediately afterward.

Uses the built-in exact camp layout by default, then builds and upgrades only after returned attacks increase the authoritative Berimond wood and stone balances. This lane never transports resources from another kingdom.
17 ground tiles, 92 functional buildings, 64 decorations, and 22 fixed targets. All 84 small and large tents plus the Auxiliaries' headquarters resolve to the terminal WoD in current official data.

The Stable level is resolved to its official Berimond WoD when the built-in target is active. An already-higher Stable is retained rather than demolished or downgraded. Maximum Large-tent steps with official premium costs stay gated by “Allow premium costs.” Custom captured targets retain their own Stable definition.
The built-in exact target is active. Capture a custom target only when you want to replace it; combat, transfers, and tool purchases remain independent.
The builder spends only the amount above these Berimond camp floors.
Construction time skips are off. Active build timers are allowed to finish normally.
Uses Berimond's find-next-tower command and the commanders assigned under Movement → Features.
An independent Auto Beri lane buys the shortage with coins in game-capped batches of up to 1,000. Set a tool to 0 to leave it unmanaged.
Only scaling ladders, battering rams, and mantlets from the coin armorer are eligible.
Leave blank to use the owned Berimond camp automatically.
Only troops whose official upkeep is Food are eligible. Mead- and Beef-consuming troops are excluded.
The selected runtime preset no longer exists. Saving the displayed configuration will safely clear that selection.

Birds are sent with a random delay between min and max hours after travel completes. Alliance castles are only used as bird targets when the member's RPT is greater than the minimum days setting (0 = any active post).
Loading castles… reopen if this stays empty.
The purchase must leave at least this many rubies untouched.
All checks are repeated immediately before premium spend.
Auto Buyer sends one bounded operation at a time, rechecks live state before spending, and verifies the server counter or timer afterward.
Invalid saved shop or specialist goals are skipped individually and do not block feast upkeep. Unresolved feast purchases are checked without spending again until the outcome is reconciled.
Each package still needs its own per-reset ruby ceiling. Specialists and ruby feasts use separate ceilings.
Loading the current official purchase catalog…
Auto Buyer stops at the purchase limit, then waits for the server stock counter to reset.
No supported stock-limited items match these filters.
No supported shops are available in the current official catalog.
Enabled floors stay between 14 and 365 days. Auto Buyer purchases one 7-day activation at a time and rechecks the authoritative timer and ruby balance.
Update the account runtime before changing or enabling feast upkeep. You can still disable the saved feast goal.
Still preserves the global ruby reserve.
Timed ruby offers are staged for a later release

Before sending resources, CitadelOps refreshes each castle’s food state so troop consumption, brewery inputs, and equipped bonuses are current. It ranks donors by net surplus, requires enough protected storage to fill the destination, then uses market barrows or allowed kingdom transport.
Storm Food and Mead wait until the configured delivery threshold is available after the kingdom-transport toll. The minimum is 10,000.
CitadelOps prefers the smallest selected skip that completes a shipment, then the largest selected partial skip. The amounts above are always kept in reserve.
Unit 277 is filled across both flanks. The runtime chooses only an available Relic 2.0 commander with the full 100% fortress speed bonus, then applies the fastest selected horse tier.
Each toggle uses that kingdom’s main castle and its private, viewer-specific cooldown rows.
One exact per-shop-session ceiling, purchased in 100-unit lots from lowest cost to highest.
Use time skips for Direwolf transfers
Off by default. When enabled, only confirmed Auto Fortress shipments can use official inventory above saved reserves.
Auto Fortress always selects the full 100% fortress-speed commander bonus and your chosen horse tier.
Auto Hospital can scan at any time.
Only levels unlocked by this player’s completed achievements are available.
Achievement data is still syncing; base difficulties are available now.
Optionally strengthen the generated castle before launching its attack. This spends the selected currency once per target.
Troop quantities adapt to the freshly resolved left, front, and right limits for each commander and target. Fortification is optional and never spends currency unless enabled above.
Auto Station has precedence. Any incoming player attack pauses new Khan attacks, cooldown skips, and defense changes while stationing runs. Khan taunts do not count as player attacks.
Stops only Auto Khan's own attack launches. Map and cooldown maintenance plus the enabled rage and defense lanes continue for a manually driven chain.
Turn this off to keep attacking and skipping cooldowns without automatically dispatching the Khan retaliation.
Once this many accepted Khan retaliations are observed in the current event, new camp attacks stop. Full-rage taunts, cooldown handling, and defense recovery continue for the rest of the event.
Gate only new automatic camp attacks unless the timed Khan Rage points booster from boi ID 27 is active. Existing taunts, cooldown handling, and defense recovery continue.
This is the timed Rage points booster, not a rage-banner attack tool.
At the limit, Auto Khan stops launching, recalls its active outgoing attacks, and opens the main-castle gates so later taunts cannot consume the defense preset.
Reaching this limit uses the game's current ruby cost for the six-hour open-gate option.
Every 30 seconds, replace preset shortages from currently active coin, Nomad/Khan, event-token, or Aquamarine shop packages.

Ruby-priced packages are rejected. Auto Khan buys only the exact missing preset tool from a package currently advertised by the server, or the captured Luna table, and only when its non-premium balance can cover the purchase.
The selected defense preset is re-applied to the Great Empire main castle before the attack chain continues.
Each launched hit reserves enough combined skip time. Every skip command uses one item, then waits for confirmation before applying another.
Cooldown skipping is required before these chained attacks can be saved and run.

At or above this threshold, Auto Khan opens the main castle gates once for six hours and immediately stops attacks, cooldown skips, and new taunts. The feature stays soft-locked without changing your settings; after the gate expires, it refreshes defense and resumes only when the projected offensive wall count is below the threshold. This uses the game's current ruby cost for the six-hour open-gate option.
The module starts the active event with this difficulty before scanning camps.
After every confirmed victory, refresh the target and spend an inventory time skip before the next chained march arrives.
Each server command uses exactly one skip. When no single skip covers the cooldown, smaller available skips are repeated one at a time after each confirmed response.
Use the Nomad preset against one robber-baron castle, size the chain from live resources, then prove every victory is followed by an immediate time-skip reset.

The chain uses every currently available selected commander supported by stationed preset copies and uncommitted response-gated RBC cooldown sequences. Any commander or troops returning from any attack can be launched on the next reevaluation without waiting for older chain marches. This mode bypasses event start and four-camp selection only for the explicit run ID created by this switch. Disable it after the trial before enabling the real Nomad/Samurai flow.
Advance each of the four nearest regular camps to the terminal victory count defined for the active difficulty.
Rank maxed camps by defense capacity plus wall, gate, and moat values, then lock the weakest.
Send the active event’s preset only to the lock, then clear the returned cooldown between every ordered arrival.

ADI must confirm the same target and zero cooldown before launch. Faster commanders are sent first, and every later CRA is sent immediately after the previous response. Batch size comes from available selected commanders, complete copies of the active event’s preset, and usable cooldown skips. Server-returned arrivals are checked for ordering, then each landed victory is cleared through the target cooldown controller. In-flight attacks can carry the final score beyond the configured threshold.
Only the highest unlocked level for each recipe type is shown.
Research unlocks have not been loaded yet. Refresh after the game is connected.
No available recipes match this search.
Schedule queue checks, control resource movement, and protect premium currency spending.
Ruby spending is limited to production slots in the Green main castle. Ruby recipes are never selected by this fallback, and the configured ruby reserve is protected.
The smallest selected skip that completes a shipment is preferred. If none completes it, the largest available selected skip is used. Configured inventory reserves are never consumed.
One item fills every slot; add more to cycle in order.
Add the first recipe for this building
No crafting buildings are loaded. Connect the game to discover them.
The four crafting castles are donors and storage too; outposts, capitals, metropolis, and Storm add more buffers.
Logistics capacity is calculated automatically from current game state and owned storage.

Station targets are the nearest protected alliance castle in the same kingdom. Sends use a one-hour station timer as a fallback even when recall is enabled. If an attack is already inside the configured window when detected, evacuation starts immediately.
These amounts remain in the castle.
Runs only when the game reports Storm locked and no owned Storm castle exists.
Choose a currently available official Storm castle.
No castle target is required for combat-only automation. Capturing one enables automated expansions, storage dependencies, logistics, construction, and layout reconciliation.
The preset may come from any castle. Its exact decoration IDs and coordinates are applied only after the building target is complete.
Multi-resource shipments may use every amount above these donor floors, limited only by the Storm castle’s free storage.
Override the captured Harbor path and maintain it at a chosen level.
Harbor levels 2–3 are premium paths and will wait until premium costs are allowed.
Attack only the selected official fort levels.
Only launch against forts with at least this many attacks remaining. Use 0 for no minimum.
Select at least one fort level.
Drag enabled targets into attack order, highest first. Distance only breaks ties between targets in the same row.
Enable forts or resource islands and select at least one target to set the attack order.
Capture matching resources and sizes, then return the report-confirmed surviving attack army to the Storm castle.
Choose dedicated occupation defenders. If empty, one survivor stays only after the successful battle report confirms the island army.
Automatic minimum occupation: after victory is reported, every surviving attack troop except one returns to the Storm castle.
Select at least one resource and one island size.
Import missing attack or configured-defense troops from selected donor castles into the Storm castle before launch. Donors never send directly to an island.
No non-Storm donor castles are currently observed.
Imports the current preset mix so this many attack troops remain stationed in Storm after the next launch.

The cap is the largest of the 5,000 baseline, confirmed Auto Storm attacks since reset ÷ 24 × average enabled-preset troops, or the amount needed for the largest preset plus your castle reserve. It counts troops stationed in Storm, away on active movements, waiting in transport, and ready to return from islands.

Donors are checked in the displayed order, and partial shortages can be filled across several transfers. Time skips use the construction-and-logistics reserve above. Attack tools must already be stationed in Storm.
Select at least one currently observed donor castle.

These 17 rewards were captured from the current Luna storefront; reward amounts, Aquamarine prices, and shop caps come from official game data. Unlimited goals obey the protected reserve and stop at Luna's stock cap when one exists.
No Luna rewards were found in the loaded official package catalog.
Use one unique Luna product per goal and a positive target count for finite goals.
Lower priority numbers run first. An uncapped unlimited goal can consume all Aquamarine above the reserve before lower-priority rewards.
Failed or interrupted full sweeps are also held to this interval.
Fast focus-switch through every enabled castle to rebuild its target list.
Advisor mode runs native same-tower chains: hit one uses a daily attack, and every additional hit uses one Time Skip.
Confirmed Advisor chains count against this cap until the game server's daily attack counter resets. Set 0 to pause Advisor launches.
No batch cap: launch every eligible target supported by a currently available selected commander and enough stationed troops. Any return from another attack can wake the next launch immediately.
Only use an available commander with the supported maiden relic.
Choose a duration from 1 minute through 7 days.
Weekly schedules and the global automation lock still apply during this window.
Stop this automation when the server's account-wide daily attack count reaches this value. It resumes automatically when the server count resets. Advisor attacks are exempt.
Queues one stack at a time in numbered order, then repeats. The next unit advances only after a successful recruit.
Recruit level 10 if glory title is lost
Off by default. When off, affected recruit slots stay softly paused until the required title returns.
Auto Recruit queues the highest currently available upgrade in this unit family.
No spy reports have been captured yet. New reports are collected when espionage notifications arrive.
The spies returned no usable troop or castle setup intelligence.
Observed positions and unit counts returned by the spy report.
Select the targets this preset is designed for. CitadelOps will show these limits in the builder and will check the real target again immediately before sending CRA.
PvE uses 30 / 40 / 30. Legendary PvP uses 40 / 50 / 40, then the active official Hall flank-tool skill adds up to +10 on the left and right. The real target is checked again before sending.
Checks equipment storage at this interval while cleanup is allowed to run.
The schedule decides when cleanup may run. The poll interval decides how often it checks while the schedule is active.
Earlier versions will appear here as they’re released.
Downloads automation settings, enabled states, schedules, priorities, presets, and portable interface preferences.
Validates the complete file before replacing matching settings on this installation.

Imported enabled automations and schedules take effect immediately. Login credentials, browser selection, logs, reports, My Stats history and its storage preference, and live game state stay on this computer and are never included.
Snapshots state already available in CitadelOps; it does not send additional game scan commands.
Choose whether CitadelOps opens the complete game or connects quietly in the background. The saved choice is used the next time CitadelOps starts.
Opens the game tab so you can play along, watch actions happen, and use the complete game interface.
Connects directly to the game server without opening Chromium or a game tab. Automations and live state continue with much lower resource use.
Uses the login and server selection saved on this computer, then derives the current client build and remaining WebSocket handshake automatically.
Connection mode changes are applied after restarting CitadelOps.
The protected saved login is present but disabled. Re-enable it explicitly to retry Background mode without exposing or re-entering the saved password.
Enter the login and server explicitly. The server code determines the official WebSocket address; CitadelOps derives only the remaining non-secret handshake values.
Saved only in this profile's protected session file and excluded from settings exports and operation receipts.

Full application mode starts with your system-default compatible Chromium browser, or the only compatible browser when one is installed. A saved choice is used after the next app restart, with a dedicated CitadelOps profile that leaves your normal browser profile untouched.
Use this for Chromium-based builds that are not detected automatically.
Wait this long after an automatic socket loss, or after a game login cooldown ends, before reconnecting and attempting the saved login again.
Default: 5 minutes. Allowed range: 1 minute to 24 hours.
Set the minimum and maximum delay (in seconds) between sent attacks. Minimum allowed value is 4.0s to avoid rate limiting.
Drag modules into priority order, highest first. Waiting time gradually raises older work; manual and scheduled attacks retain protected priority.
Pause between each enchant command when bulk-upgrading equipment or gems (10–5000 ms).
Block equipment and gem upgrades when your coin balance is at or below this reserve.
Hover to inspect a public observation. Drag horizontally to inspect a custom time period.
Collected alliance event rankings appear here when their public leaderboard is available.
No additional public event score has been observed for this alliance yet.
Name, Might, Honor, and Alliance stay visible while the selected event adds its Rank and Score columns.
Final known public score from each completed event run. End dates and times use this device's local time.
Hover to inspect a public observation. Drag horizontally to inspect a custom time period.
Gallantry, gacha spins, timestamps, and other one-off public values appear here when their event or board is available. Chartable Storm values are available in the graph above.
No additional public event score has been observed for this player yet. Optional boards are discovered independently so an inactive event cannot interrupt the core World Intel scan.
No player name or alliance changes have been observed.
